text:
Type: textured bohemian area rug
Use: grounding a chair or seating corner; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: bohemian, contemporary, farmhouse
Materials: woven yarn with raised high-low pile, short fringe
Colors: cream white, grey, charcoal
Shape: rectangular, raised cream trellis and diamond bands over herringbone stripes, fringed ends, medium size
Feel: cozy, tactile, casual
Goes with: dark wood, woven baskets, neutral walls; boho or farmhouse rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Modern Textured Subtle Bohemian Area Rug, 4 x 6 Foot, Grey and White Multicolor
product.description: Bring a sense of bohemian luxury into your home with this fashionable rug. The muted hues emphasize the beautiful diamond pattern, and the textured shapes make this rug soft and irresistible. 4' x 6' 79% wool, 21% cotton Preserving the global craft tradition, this beautifully textured rug is handcrafted by Craftmark-certified artisans. Flatweave (pile is not applicable) Pair with rug pad (sold separately)
